item.title: The Green Mile
item.description:
This movie is impressive due to two reasons: first one is the storytelling in a nostalgic manner with a balanced approach to magic realism. The second one is a strong star cast, especially Tom Hanks. His acting is always fascinating due to his ability to deal with complex scenes, with hard emotions. I have seen a very few actors who can do that.

The story revolves around the protagonist, Paul Edgecomb, the head of a prison, who witnesses healing powers of a falsely acquitted African man. He learns from his first hand experiences that the African man is innocent but he can not do anything. It is a complicated situation where he is bound to do his duty while it is also wrong to swing the death sentence of an innocent man with divine powers. This dilemma leads to situations which has deep impact on you (the viewer), and for which you should watch the movie.

I loved every minute of the movie. Highly recommend it. 5 stars.
item.dc:creator: Rishabh

item.title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai (1999)
item.description:
A weird crime cinema, at least for modern times, amalgamating criminal mind with Samurai code. That's exactly the theme of the movie.

A professional killer, alias Ghost Dog, strictly follows Samurai code. He is a big fan of Japanese culture, and an avid reader who repeatedly quote many times from a book Hagakure—a practical and spiritual guide for a warrior written in nineteenth century—throughout the movie.

The story line is simple, a killer eliminating people who want to kill him, and yet it leaves a deep impact. I think one need to watch it again to understand it properly. I recommend it with 4 stars.`
item.dc:creator: Rishabh

item.title: The Odyssey (2026)
item.description:
I feel bad that I have not heard about The Odyssey earlier but thanks to Nolan as he made a movie about it.

The storyline is taken from a famous ancient Greek epic composed by Homer about a man Odysseus who was forced to go on a war, leaving his wife and new born son. The journey costs him twenty years to come back. In this journey he meet many mythological creatures such as one eyed giant, and face wrath of Poseidon, the sea God.

What I liked about the movie is that Nolan managed to keep the lessons of moral and ethics, along with human struggles of Odysseus in a story made up with gods and witches. I mean he could have make it as a plain fictional movie focused on magic and myths, but he did not. Its a welcome approach.

I highly recommend it. It deserves 5 stars
item.dc:creator: Rishabh

item.title: The Mandalorian and Grogu (2026)
item.description:
If you are a fan of Star Wars, and you have seen Disney tv series, The Mandalorian (2019), this movie is going to be a fun. Otherwise, you will find a few aliens fighting with each other, and a tiny baby alien (he is actually 300 years old) doing his cute things.

That cute alien, Grogu, is the key strength of the movie. He is a bit grown up in the movie—compared to the series—and acts as a son of prodigious bounty hunter who belongs to an alien race Mandalorian. The duo has emotional moments which can make you cry.

I recommend it for at least one time watch. 3 stars.
item.dc:creator: Rishabh

item.title: Border 2 (2026)
item.description:
A follow up movie—or a remake—of Border. Basic idea is the same but this movie is even worse. Again the core strength of the movie could be music which makers copied from the original. But they made it worse. Only good songs in this movie are recreated popular songs from the original Border. Rest is just garbage.

I somehow finished it. So don't bother to waste your time. Just watch the video songs on YouTube, and that is it. 2 stars.
item.dc:creator: Rishabh

item.title: Border (1997)
item.description:
Its pretty old movie—thirty four years old, but its songs are still popular. So I must have heard it somewhere, and therefore decided to watch it.

Since it was released three decades ago, it is for a different audience. The movie is about Pakistan invasion of India around 70s. There was a big conflict, and emergency was declared. Unfortunately at the location of invasion there were only 120 soldiers so you can imagine how bloody that fight would be. In the end, India won but lost most of the soldiers in that battalion.

The movie captures the emotion of patriotism with beautiful music. So if you are fan of either, I recommend it with 4 stars.
item.dc:creator: Rishabh

item.title: Disclosure Day (2026)
item.description:
Aliens are around us but government is trying to keep it a secret for almost 7-8 decades. Worst part is that the DOD and a private corporation is developing technology by experimenting on captured aliens.

Good people fights back as they understood that the aliens belongs to an evolved species who lives with empathy instead of fear as we humans do.

It was a nice movie which I will rewatch for sure. 4 stars
item.dc:creator: Rishabh

item.title: Hereafter (2010)
item.description:
I watched it in flight to Delhi last month and later after landing I completely forgot its name. Then I found it last week in the flight from Delhi. What an adventure LOL.

The movie is about three people who experience life after death separately at some point in their life. This binds them in a way because no one else believe them while there experiences has some common grounds.

So its simply their story beautifully told in the movie. I recommend it with 4 stars
